        - heading "How to read" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Observe residuals around zero, check for curves or fan shapes, then decide whether the model is reasonable.
      - article:
        - heading "Key concept" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Residual = observed − predicted. A good linear model has randomly scattered residuals with constant spread.
      - article:
        - heading "Common misconception" [level=3]
        - paragraph: A high R² does not automatically mean a good model. Always inspect the residual plot.
